title: From Scores to Evidence: Auditable Decisions Can Improve Speech Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.08899v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech deepfakes can mimic a speaker's voice convincingly enough to deceive listeners and automated systems. This has driven strong progress in speech deepfake detection, but most detectors still end with one score per utterance. That score is useful for ranking systems, yet it says little about why a borderline item should be trusted, deferred, or reviewed. Two utterances can fall in the same score band for different reasons, for example because passive and retrieval evidence disagree or because the keyed probe is unavailable. We ask whether the final decision can remain scalar without discarding that provenance. We answer this question with an auditable decision record that carries four aligned cues into a late calibration step: a passive detector score, a conditional keyed-probe score on a marked derivative, retrieval support, and a speaker-profile margin, together with explicit disagreement coordinates. On the 4,080-example

translated_title: 从分数到证据：可审计的决策可以改进语音深伪检测
translated_abstract: 语音深伪能够以足以欺骗听众和自动化系统的方式逼真地模仿说话者的声音。这推动了语音深伪检测领域的强劲进展，但大多数检测器最终仍只输出每条语音的一个分数。该分数对于排序系统很有用，但对于为什么某个临界样本应该被信任、搁置还是复核，它几乎没有提供任何信息。两条语音可能因不同原因落入同一分数区间，例如被动证据与检索证据不一致，或者键控探针不可用。我们提出了一个问题：最终决策能否在保留这些来源信息的前提下仍然保持标量形式。我们通过一种可审计的决策记录来回答这个问题，该记录将四个对齐的线索引入后期校准步骤：被动检测器分数、在标记衍生样本上的条件性键控探针分数、检索支持度以及说话者画像边际，同时附带明确的分歧坐标。在包含4,080个样本的……
tldr: 该论文提出一种可审计的决策记录方法，将被动检测分数、条件性键控探针分数、检索支持和说话者画像边际四个线索纳入后期校准步骤，使语音深伪检测的最终决策在保持标量的同时保留证据来源信息，从而提升检测决策的可信度与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an auditable decision record that carries four aligned cues—a passive detector score, a conditional keyed-probe score, retrieval support, and a speaker-profile margin—into a late calibration step, enabling speech deepfake detection to keep scalar final decisions while preserving evidential provenance for improved trustworthiness and auditability.
